summary: Set.prototype.union and a local GetSetRecord helper are implemented in the expected order: RequireInternalSlot, GetSetRecord (Get size, ToNumber, NaN check, ToIntegerOrInfinity, negative RangeError, Get has, IsCallable, Get keys, IsCallable), GetIteratorFromMethod, copy of [[SetData]], then the IteratorStepValue loop with CanonicalizeKeyedCollectionKey and SetDataHas before append. No test-specific branches, no fabricated values, and no swallowed errors were found. The gate's still-failing tests fail on other built-ins (Set.prototype.size getter, SetIteratorPrototype.next, Map.prototype.size) that this ticket does not own. The one ordering change, creating the result object before the copy, is not observable. Remaining concern: GC rooting is not verified in the window between object_with_kind and with_roots.
notes_for_next_attempt: The diff matches the spec and can be kept as is. Two things to check before landing. (1) Under KAHVI_GC_STRESS=1, keys_iterator.iterator and next_method are not rooted between get_iterator_from_method and with_roots. The result object is allocated in that window via object_with_kind, so if that allocation can trigger GC, root the iterator earlier. (2) The result object is created before step 5's copy. This is not observable, but the step-8 comment sits out of order with the code; that is acceptable. Remaining failures in the gate report belong to Set.prototype.size, SetIteratorPrototype.next and Map.prototype.size, which are separate tickets.
